pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit polygonal geometries with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area of patches is largest on the mid-flank, progressively decreasing in size and increasing in density towards the dorsal ridge and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous inter-patch lattice. Junction nodes predominantly feature three-way intersections. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the lateral surface, with slight narrowing observed at the dorsal transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour against the background. The silhouette is composed of fine, vertically oriented hair tufts creating a consistent jagged edge.
